coherence-neuro-2026.tagline: An implantable device that monitors tumors in real time and treats them with electrical stimulation
coherence-neuro-2026.team_highlights: Dr. Matthew MacDougall, Chief Neurosurgeon at Neuralink, serves on the medical advisory board, and Dr. Rory Murphy, neurosurgeon at Barrow Neurological Institute, has joined as an investor and advisor.

product.summary: Coherence Neuro is a closed-loop system implanted at the brain tumor site in glioblastoma patients. It continuously measures electrical activity and applies electrical stimulation when needed to suppress tumor regrowth. An external wearable device wirelessly powers the implant and collects data, and patients and clinicians can monitor status through a dedicated app.
product.problem_statement: Conventional cancer treatment is static and non-adaptive, making it difficult to respond quickly when tumors recur. MRI scans are only performed at intervals of months, so recurrence can be missed.
product.solution: A learning-based approach in which a small implant (SOMA) inserted during brain surgery continuously measures electrical signals around the tumor, and an algorithm detects anomalies and immediately delivers personalized electrical stimulation.
key_features: SOMA implant: button-sized, with 16 ultra-thin threads that measure electrical activity and stimulate surrounding tissue
Wearable: wireless charging and data transmission, attaches to the outer ear, allows normal daily life
App: patients log symptoms and energy levels; clinicians view real-time data and adjust stimulation remotely
Background treatment: charges during sleep, operates autonomously 24/7
product.tech_stack_or_innovation: Combining bioelectronic materials science, neurological recording technology, and machine learning models to discover electrical biomarkers and track tumor status. The implant is wirelessly powered and transmits data.
product.target_customer: Patients with glioblastoma; long-term expansion planned to other solid tumors such as pancreatic cancer
product.business_model: Specific model not yet disclosed, but as a medical device, either one-time device sales or a subscription model for ongoing treatment services is expected.

direct_competitors.comparison: An FDA-approved tumor-treating-field device used for glioblastoma, but it does not record tumor electrical activity, provides only simple stimulation, and has no learning capability.

competitive_landscape.key_differentiator: The closed-loop design performs recording and stimulation simultaneously, accumulating data over time to improve treatment.
competitive_landscape.moat: Ultra-thin implantable electrode technology, proprietary database of electrical tumor biomarkers, machine-learning-based predictive models, and a clinical neurosurgery network
competitive_landscape.competitive_position_summary: The first startup to attempt a closed-loop implantable device for tumor treatment, with strong support from AI investors and the medical community. A more advanced adaptive approach than existing electrical stimulation therapy (Novocure).

product.summary: PhotonPay builds a next-generation Financial OS that lets enterprises use stablecoin liquidity and fiat payment networks through a single API. It integrates multi-asset wallets, global card issuance, local clearing, and embedded finance on one platform.
product.problem_statement: Traditional cross-border payments are slow and expensive, while stablecoin on-chain payments are disconnected from the banking, card, and local clearing networks enterprises actually need for real-world use.
product.solution: Provides an API-first Financial OS that connects stablecoin liquidity with existing financial infrastructure. Businesses can handle asset conversion, FX, international remittances, card issuance, and local settlement in one place.
key_features: Multi-asset stablecoin wallet integrated with fiat balances
Local receiving accounts in 17 key markets and 60+ currencies
100+ remittance routes and integration with 74 major local e-wallets
API-based virtual and physical card issuance with granular spend controls
Planned MCP support for embedded finance and AI agent payments
Policy-based execution framework to control agent payment approval limits

In May 2026, completed a live demo with Mastercard of an AI agent executing payments using tokenized cards. Plans to support Model Context Protocol (MCP) to offer accounts, balances, cards, and payments as composable financial primitives for developers and agents.
product.target_customer: B2B enterprises operating in 200+ countries, digital platforms, fintech and enterprise companies adopting embedded finance. Especially SMEs and mid-market companies with frequent cross-border remittances and international settlements.
product.business_model: Revenue based on remittance and FX fees, card issuance and usage fees, and embedded finance API usage fees. Specific pricing not disclosed.

product.summary: An 'Enterprise Execution OS' where a company's operational processes run on a single platform. AI agents execute real work across ERP systems such as SAP, supplier portals, spreadsheets, and inboxes, route decisions and exceptions that require judgment to the right people, and performance is reviewed in an operations cockpit.
product.problem_statement: Enterprise operational processes span multiple disconnected systems: SAP, supplier portals, spreadsheets, email, and more. Costs arise in the manual gaps between systems, and enterprise AI stalls at the pilot stage, fragmented into separate projects.
product.solution: Duvo Clarity captures how work is actually done through interviews with business users, screen recordings, and document analysis. AI agents then execute approved procedures via APIs or existing UIs when no API exists. The first process can go live within weeks, and every approval and system change is recorded.
key_features: Duvo Clarity: captures real processes via AI-driven interviews, screen recordings, and document analysis
Agents execute in ERP, supplier portals, spreadsheets, and inboxes via API or existing UIs
Automatically routes decisions and exceptions to the right people and applies approval rules consistently
Operations cockpit gives real-time visibility into pending decisions and process performance

SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and ISO 42001 certified, and available on Microsoft Azure Marketplace

product.target_customer: Starting with retail and CPG companies (Morrisons, Holland & Barrett, Boden, Notino, Allegro), then finance, supply chain, commerce, customer service, marketing, and HR operations. Entering the US market through retail and CPG as well.

competitive_landscape.key_differentiator: The core differentiator is operating the first process within weeks without large-scale system integration or engineering input, and mapping the 'owner' of every exception to guarantee human approval.

founders.notable_achievement: Team leader who won the 2023 ICRA quadruped robot competition, beating MIT by a margin of more than 4x.

eurobotics-2026.team_highlights: Co-founded by three alumni of KAIST Future City Robotics Lab (Prof. Myeong-hyeon). KAIST faculty advise on technology and investment network. Selected for Samsung Electronics C-Lab Outside 2026.

product.summary: A universal autonomous walking and full-body control AI software and modular hardware kit applicable to any robot model.
product.problem_statement: Industrial sites (construction, shipbuilding, energy, defense) are unstructured rough terrain and mixed indoor/outdoor environments, so existing remote-controlled or pre-mapped robots do not work properly. Relying on expensive sensors (LiDAR, surround cameras) increases robot unit cost, hindering deployment.
product.solution: DreamWaQ, a deep learning-based controller that 'imagines' terrain using only joint encoders and inertial sensors, and DreamWaQ++, which adds cameras and LiDAR for proactive obstacle avoidance. This technology is packaged into a single module called E-DONG-KIT, which can be applied to any robot platform within 2-24 hours.
key_features: Blind walking controller: walks on rough terrain (35° slopes, stairs, gravel, tree roots, etc.) using only internal sensors, without visual/tactile sensors.
DreamWaQ++: Combines cameras and LiDAR to pre-detect obstacles and change walking strategy in real time.
E-DONG-KIT: A modular kit integrating processor and sensors, attachable/detachable to various robot models.
Locomanipulation: Integrated control technology enabling object manipulation while walking.
Hardware-independent: Universal application without being tied to specific manufacturer hardware.
product.tech_stack_or_innovation: Training on simulators based on deep reinforcement learning. A structure of situation estimation network + policy network that implicitly estimates terrain using only robot joint and inertial data without explicit terrain modeling.
product.target_customer: Companies and institutions performing autonomous inspection in construction/energy, process automation in shipbuilding/steel, and unmanned reconnaissance/hazard zone exploration in defense. Also supplies OEM to humanoid and quadruped robot manufacturers (e.g., Robotis).
product.business_model: Software license + royalty (revenue sharing). Sale of E-DONG-KIT hardware. Revenue from national R&D projects.

product.summary: A modular chemical plant that converts methane gas from landfills, livestock farms, wastewater treatment plants, and industrial facilities into biomethanol and liquid fuels on-site at the gas source. product.problem_statement: Most of the world's waste methane resources lack pipeline or processing infrastructure, so they are flared or released directly into the atmosphere. Conventional large-scale gas-to-chemical plants require hundreds of millions of dollars in capital and over five years to build, making them economically unviable for distributed small gas sources.
product.solution: Operates a commercial internal combustion engine under 'fuel-rich' conditions to partially oxidize methane, then synthesizes methanol from the resulting CO/H₂ syngas. Based on off-the-shelf engines, it avoids the need for large custom equipment and runs on its own power generation without grid electricity. Pre-assembled units can be deployed on-site and are targeted to be operational within one year.
key_features: Onsite: Converts gas directly to liquid fuel at the source — no pipelines or trucking needed
Modular: Scales by adding standardized units — no large-scale engineering required
Rapid Deployment: Pre-assembled and shipped, with minimal site work, operational within one year
Off-grid: Self-powered, no external electricity needed
~8 tons/day methanol per unit (based on 300,000 scf/day gas, per MIT News)

It partially oxidizes methane under fuel-rich conditions (not full combustion) to produce syngas, protected by MIT's patent portfolio and ARPA-E demonstration projects.
product.target_customer: Landfill, dairy, wastewater, and industrial flare operators with waste gas, and shipping, aviation, heavy transport, and specialty chemical industries needing low-carbon fuel. product.summary: Restate is an infrastructure that provides 'Durable Execution' to developers. It safely records the progress of running tasks, allowing them to resume seamlessly after failures. Used widely from AI agent long-running workflows to enterprise financial transactions.
product.problem_statement: Distributed systems and AI agents frequently experience network failures, crashes, and timeouts during long-running execution. Traditionally, developers had to manually implement retry, state persistence, and recovery logic. AI agents, in particular, involve many model/tool/API calls, increasing failure probability.
product.solution: Restate writes execution progress to a distributed log at the runtime level, so that after any failure it automatically resumes from the last committed state. Developers can focus on logic without needing separate recovery code.
key_features: Virtual Objects: stateful entities that isolate state and execution per key, minimizing concurrency control and latency.
Durable Actions: durably commit each step execution for fast commit and recovery.

desibleai-2026.tagline: Agentic workflow orchestration platform for regulated BFSI enterprises in India

founders.background: Former investment banker with 12+ years of enterprise sales and startup leadership experience
founders.notable_achievement: Sold previous venture Business Toys in 2023; subsequently conducted AI consulting for US companies including Newsweek, Bank of America, and Nestlé (YourStory interview)

founders.background: 12+ years in machine learning and statistical modeling; previously at Crisil and Edelweiss
founders.notable_achievement: Co-founded and exited an edtech startup; designed an orchestration system that reduced per-call execution cost from ₹7-8 to ₹1.5-2

desibleai-2026.team_highlights: The two co-founders have known each other for 17 years. In a YourStory interview, they explicitly described the strategy: 'Voice is a commodity, workflow is a moat.'

product.summary: An agentic orchestration platform that automates customer engagement, operations, service, and compliance workflows for Indian BFSI (banking, insurance) enterprises using AI agents. Started with voice and is expanding to WhatsApp, SMS, and email.
product.problem_statement: There are many demo-stage voice AI solutions, but few reach production deployment in regulated enterprises (founders estimate PoC conversion rate below 35-40%). Security audits alone require over 450 questions, and voice itself has become commoditized, making differentiation difficult.
product.solution: Provides 'deep workflow agents' connected to internal enterprise processes. Embeds Indian regulatory requirements (IRDAI, TRAI/DLT, RBI, DPDPA) into workflow design and executes notices, consents, and escalations deterministically to ensure auditability.
key_features: Insurance Pre-Qualification AI Agent: Collects customer data, filters high-intent leads, routes to sales team
25+ workflows: Revenue, Risk/Compliance, Collections, Underwriting, Service, Claims
Supports call interruption, multilingual multi-turn conversations, enterprise system lookups
Multi-channel expansion: Voice, WhatsApp, SMS, Email
Billed per workflow execution, not per call
product.tech_stack_or_innovation: Agentic orchestration reduces per-call execution cost from the industry standard of ₹7-8 to ₹1.5-2 (founder interview). The core technical innovation is deterministic, auditable workflow design for regulatory compliance.
product.target_customer: Large BFSI institutions such as Indian insurers and banks. Future expansion to intermediaries including TPAs (third-party administrators), brokers, and health aggregators. 40+ BFSI institutions are using or evaluating the platform.
product.business_model: Enterprise SaaS. Instead of per-call pricing, the platform charges per workflow execution, ensuring revenue is generated only when AI completes a real business task.

direct_competitors.comparison: A strong Indian voice AI player with strengths in collections and customer service automation. Desible differentiates by going beyond voice to orchestrate workflows such as insurance renewals and claims.
A global enterprise conversational AI and contact center analytics platform. Also present in India, but not purpose-built for BFSI regulatory workflows, contrasting with Desible.
An enterprise conversational AI platform targeting BFSI as well, but Desible's level of embedded regulatory compliance in workflow execution is distinct.

competitive_landscape.key_differentiator: Strategy: 'Voice is a commodity, workflow is a moat.' Building a BFSI-specific orchestration layer with regulatory requirements embedded in its design.
competitive_landscape.moat: Workflows become deeply embedded in enterprise processes, increasing switching costs. The compliance infrastructure that passed 450 security questions and data locality requirements creates a barrier for latecomers. High call volume data creates a workflow improvement loop.
competitive_landscape.competitive_position_summary: Despite being at seed stage, the company processes over 10 million interactions per month and is emerging as a front-runner in BFSI AI workflow orchestration in India.

With over 10 million monthly customer interactions and 40+ BFSI institutions using or evaluating the platform, it is gaining attention as a 'production AI, not demo' case.

market_outlook.market_trend: Voice AI is moving beyond demo stage to actual production deployment, leading to contact center workforce reduction (e.g., from 25 to 3 people). Enterprises are seeking workflow-complete orchestration platforms rather than single bots.
market_outlook.growth_potential: Over 20 additional workflows identified for insurance renewals alone. Demand for auditable AI workflows under regulatory environments (IRDAI, RBI, DPDPA) is growing, presenting significant expansion potential beyond Indian BFSI into similarly regulated industries.
risks: PoC-to-production conversion rate below 35-40% (founder estimate), leading to long enterprise sales cycles
If AI effectiveness is proven, clients may reduce contact centers, potentially decreasing contract size (case: three regional contact centers not renewed within four months)
Voice AI commoditization could lead to price competition with global LLM and voice platforms
Changes in IRDAI, TRAI/DLT, RBI, DPDPA regulations would require compliance redesign
market_outlook.risk_mitigation: Revenue model diversified by charging per workflow execution rather than per call; early funds invested in compliance infrastructure to internalize regulatory barriers. Dependence on voice revenue spread across WhatsApp, SMS, and email channels.
